1	# Orchard — The Best Way to Buy the Products You Love
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	Orchard is a premium technology brand's official online store offering the latest devices, accessories, financing options, and personalized shopping experiences. The tone is minimal, modern, and professional — clean layouts with generous whitespace, product-forward imagery, and concise copy.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #1D1D1F (primary dark), #F5F5F7 (light background), #6E6E73 (secondary text)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: Store
    10	Subtitle: The best way to buy the products you love.
    11	CTA: "Connect with a Specialist" | "Find an Orchard Store" | "Visit an Orchard Store"
    12	
    13	## Product Categories
    14	Horizontal icon bar for quick navigation across the full catalog:
    15	- Laptop
    16	- Phone
    17	- Tablet
    18	- Smartwatch
    19	- Headphones
    20	- Tracker
    21	- Streaming Box
    22	- Smart Speaker
    23	- Accessories
    24	- Orchard Gift Card
    25	
    26	## Latest Products
    27	Section heading: "The latest."
    28	Subheading: "Take a look at what's new, right now."
    29	
    30	| Product | Tagline | Price | Monthly Option | Badge |
    31	|---|---|---|---|---|
    32	| Phone 17 Pro | All out Pro. | From $1,099 | $45.79/mo. for 24 mo. | NEW |
    33	| Laptop Neo | The magic of Laptop at a surprising price. | From $599 | $49.91/mo. for 12 mo. | NEW |
    34	| Phone 17e | Feature stacked. Value packed. | From $549 | $22.87/mo. for 24 mo. | NEW |
    35	| Headphones Max 2 | New intelligent features. More immersive listening. | $549 | $91.50/mo. for 6 mo. | NEW |
    36	| Laptop Pro | Now with O5, O5 Pro, and O5 Max. | From $1,699 | $141.58/mo. for 12 mo. | NEW |
    37	| Laptop Air | Now supercharged by O5. | From $1,099 | $91.58/mo. for 12 mo. | NEW |
    38	| Tablet Air | Now supercharged by O4. | From $599 | $49.91/mo. for 12 mo. | NEW |
    39	| Smartwatch Series 11 | The ultimate way to watch your health. | From $399 | $33.25/mo. for 12 mo. | — |
    40	| Phone 17 | Magichromatic. | From $799 | $33.29/mo. for 24 mo. | — |
    41	| Phone Air | The thinnest Phone ever. | From $999 | $41.62/mo. for 24 mo. | — |
    42	
    43	## Homepage Product Showcase
    44	Grid of large hero tiles on the homepage, each with product name, tagline, and dual CTAs ("Learn more" / "Buy"):
    45	
    46	- **Phone** — Meet the latest Phone lineup.
    47	- **Laptop Neo** — Amazing Laptop. Surprising price.
    48	- **Tablet Pro** — Advanced AI performance and game-changing capabilities.
    49	- **Laptop Pro** — Now with O5, O5 Pro, and O5 Max.
    50	- **Earbuds Pro 3** — The world's best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation.
    51	- **Trade In** — Get up to $195–$685 in credit when you trade in Phone 13 or higher.
    52	
    53	## Accessories
    54	Section heading: "Accessories."
    55	Subheading: "Essentials that pair perfectly with your favorite devices."
    56	
    57	| Product | Price |
    58	|---|---|
    59	| Phone 17 Pro Silicone Case – Bright Guava | $49.00 |
    60	| Crossbody Strap – Bright Guava | $59.00 |
    61	| MagCharge Charger (1 m) | $39.00 |
    62	| Magic Keyboard for Tablet Air 13-inch – Black | $319.00 |
    63	| Phone Air Battery Pack | $99.00 |
    64	
    65	## Audio Products
    66	Section heading: "Loud and clear."
    67	Subheading: "Unparalleled choices for rich, high-quality sound."
    68	Promo: "Get 3 months of Orchard Music free — included with the purchase of select devices."
    69	
    70	| Product | Price | Note |
    71	|---|---|---|
    72	| Headphones Max 2 – Midnight | $549.00 | Free Engraving |
    73	| Earbuds Pro 3 | $249.00 | Free Engraving |

    76	| SmartSpeaker – Midnight | $299.00 | — |
    77	| SmartSpeaker mini – Orange | $99.00 | — |
    78	
    79	## Help & Support
    80	Section heading: "Help is here."
    81	Subheading: "Whenever and however you need it."
    82	
    83	- **Orchard Specialist** — Shop one on one with a Specialist. Online or in a store.
    84	- **Video Shopping** — Choose your next device in a guided, one-way video session.
    85	- **Today at Orchard** — Join free sessions at your Orchard Store to explore the latest features.
    86	- **Personal Setup** — Set up your new device with help from a Specialist — data transfer, features, and more.
    87	- **Genius Bar** — Get expert service and support at the Genius Bar.
    88	
    89	## Store Difference
    90	Section heading: "The Orchard Store difference."
    91	Subheading: "Even more reasons to shop with us."
    92	
    93	- **Trade-In** — Trade in your current device. Get credit toward a new one.
    94	- **Flexible Payment** — Pay in full or pay over time. Your choice.
    95	- **Personalization** — Engrave a mix of emoji, names, and numbers for free.
    96	- **Fast Delivery** — Enjoy two-hour delivery from an Orchard Store, free delivery, or easy pickup.
    97	- **Store App** — Get a personalized shopping experience in the Orchard Store app.
    98	- **Customization** — Customize a Laptop and style a Smartwatch just for them.

   116	|---|---|---|---|

   120	| Tablet mini | From $499 | $41.58/mo. for 12 mo. | — |
   121	
   122	## Shopping Guides
   123	Section heading: "Shopping guides. Can't decide? Start here."
   124	
   125	- **Compare All Models** — Which [Laptop/Tablet] is right for you?
   126	- **Orchard Intelligence** — Create, communicate, and get things done effortlessly.
   127	- **Video Shopping** — Choose your next device in a guided, one-way video session.
   128	- **Specialist** — Shop one on one with a Specialist. Online or in a store.
   129	- **Today at Orchard** — Explore Orchard Intelligence in a free session at the Orchard Store.
   130	
   131	## Ways to Save
   132	Section heading: "Ways to save. Find what works for you."
   133	
   134	- **Orchard Trade In** — Save on a new device when you trade in an eligible device.
   135	- **Low Monthly Payments** — Pay 0% APR over 12 months with Orchard Card Monthly Installments.
   136	- **Orchard Card** — Get 3% back in Daily Cash with Orchard Card.
   137	- **Certified Refurbished** — Shop refurbished Orchard products backed by a one-year warranty.
   138	- **Education Pricing** — Save with education pricing on the Education Store.
   139	
   140	## Savings & Special Stores
   141	Section heading: "Savings and offers. Exclusive deals, special stores and more."
   142	
   143	- **Carrier Deals** — Get up to $800–$1,100 in credit on a new Phone after trade-in.
   144	- **Education** — Buy a new Laptop or Tablet with education savings.
   145	- **Certified Refurbished** — Shop refurbished products backed by a one-year warranty.
   146	- **Small Business** — Simple solutions for all the ways you work.
   147	- **Government** — Special pricing for state, local, and federal agencies.
   148	- **Veterans and Military** — Active and veteran members may be eligible for exclusive savings.
   149	
   150	## Brand Collaboration
   151	Section heading: "Athletica × SoundPro. Sport with style."
   152	Subheading: "Two icons join forces to level up your workout."
   153	Includes co-branded earbuds, sport bands, and phone cases with curated workout playlists on Orchard Music.
   154	
   155	## Entertainment Carousel
   156	Section heading: "Endless entertainment."
   157	Tabbed interface with categories: Streaming, Fitness, Gaming, Music. Each tab reveals content cards with show/game/playlist titles and "Stream now," "Play now," or "Listen now" CTAs.
   158	
   159	## Quick Links

   163	| Order Status |
   164	| Shopping Help |
   165	| Returns |

   168	## Ribbon Banner
   169	Promotional banner at the top of the homepage:
   170	"Recycle an eligible device in a store and get 10% off an Orchard accessory. Find a store →"

   175	- **Account:** Manage Your Account · Orchard Store Account · Cloud Account

   177	- **Orchard Store:** Find a Store · Genius Bar · Today at Orchard · Certified Refurbished · Orchard Trade In · Financing · Order Status · Shopping Help
   178	- **For Business:** Orchard and Business · Shop for Business
   179	- **For Education:** Orchard and Education · Shop for Education
   180

     2	name: web-design-expert
     3	description: Creates unique web designs with brand identity, color palettes, typography, and modern UI/UX patterns. Use for brand identity development, visual design systems, layout composition, and responsive
     4	  web design. Activate on "web design", "brand identity", "color palette", "UI design", "visual design", "layout". NOT for typography details (use typography-expert), color theory deep-dives (use color-theory-expert),
     5	  design system tokens (use design-system-creator), or code implementation without design direction.
     6	allowed-tools: Read,Write,Edit,WebFetch,mcp__magic__21st_magic_component_builder,mcp__magic__21st_magic_component_inspiration,mcp__magic__21st_magic_component_refiner,mcp__magic__logo_search

    20	---
    21	
    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147	
   148	**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus
   153	
   154	## Output Deliverables
   155	
   156	1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
   157	2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
   158	3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
   159	4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets
   160	
   161	## MCP Tools
   162	
   163	| Tool | Purpose |
   164	|------|---------|
   165	| `21st_magic_component_inspiration` | Search UI patterns for inspiration |
   166	| `21st_magic_component_builder` | Generate React/Tailwind components |
   167	| `21st_magic_component_refiner` | Improve existing component UI |
   168	| `logo_search` | Get company logos in JSX/TSX/SVG |
   169	
   170	## Integration with Other Skills
   171	
   172	Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:
   173	
   174	| Skill | Path | Use For |
   175	|-------|------|---------|
   176	| **typography-expert** | `typography-expert/SKILL.md` | Deep typography decisions, font pairing, OpenType features |
   177	| **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert** | `color-theory-palette-harmony-expert/SKILL.md` | Color science, palette harmony, perceptual color spaces |
   178	| **design-system-creator** | `design-system-creator/SKILL.md` | Design tokens, CSS architecture, component libraries |
   179	| **vibe-matcher** | `vibe-matcher/SKILL.md` | Translating emotional vibes to visual DNA |
   180	| **design-archivist** | `design-archivist/SKILL.md` | Building visual databases, competitive research |
   181	
   182	## Reference Files
   183	
   184	| File | Contents |
   185	|------|----------|
   186	| `references/layout-systems.md` | Grid systems, spacing scales, responsive breakpoints |
   187	| `references/color-accessibility.md` | Palettes, psychology, dark mode, WCAG compliance |
   188	| `references/tooling-integration.md` | 21st.dev, Figma MCP, component workflows |
   189	
   190	---
   191	
   192	*The best design is invisible until you notice its excellence.*

todos.title: Create shared CSS and JS utilities
Verify navigation, pricing accuracy, and interactions

steps.message:
The Orchard e-commerce website is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Files Output to `/app/output/`

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Homepage with ribbon banner, hero, 6-tile product grid, entertainment tabs |
| `store.html` | Full store page with icon bar, latest products, help, accessories, audio, savings |
| `shop-laptops.html` | Laptop category page with sticky section nav, all models carousel, guides |
| `shop-tablets.html` | Tablet category page with sticky section nav, all models carousel, guides |
| `styles.css` | Shared design system — carousels, cards, nav, footer, responsive breakpoints |
| `main.js` | Carousel scrolling, entertainment tabs, footer accordion |

### Key Features Implemented

- **Carousels** — Horizontal scrollable carousels with visible prev/next arrows on every page (latest products, accessories, audio, models, savings, help, etc.)
- **Homepage Product Grid** — 6 large hero tiles (Phone, Laptop Neo, Tablet Pro, Laptop Pro, Earbuds Pro 3, Trade In) with "Learn more" / "Buy" CTAs
- **Entertainment Tabs** — Instant tab switching between Streaming, Fitness, Gaming, and Music with corresponding content panels
- **Pricing Accuracy** — All prices and financing amounts match `source_brief.md` exactly (e.g., Phone 17 Pro at $1,099 / $45.79/mo., Laptop Neo at $599 / $49.91/mo., etc.)
- **Sticky Section Navigation** — On laptops & tablets pages, horizontal nav smooth-scrolls to anchors (All Models, Shopping Guides, Ways to Save, etc.)
- **Footer Accordion** — Footer sections collapse/expand on mobile via JavaScript
- **Navigation** — All inter-page links work as specified (Store ↔ Laptops ↔ Tablets, homepage to all pages, icon bar links)
- **Responsive** — Mobile-first with grid collapsing to single column, footer accordion activating below 768px, nav links hiding on mobile
